title: Flood Relief Operation
situation: A flash flood has struck a remote village of approximately 800 residents. Roads are washed out and the village is cut off. You are leading a team of 8 with a 45-minute window before sunset. The administrative HQ is 30 km away.
problems: Around 30 people are trapped on rooftops, including 5 elderly and 2 children.
The local school building is structurally unsafe and may collapse.
Food and drinking water stocks are depleted. Village has no potable water.
A pregnant woman requires urgent evacuation for medical care.
Communication lines are down. The only working phone belongs to the village sarpanch.
resources: 1 vehicle in working condition at the village outskirts
Sarpanch's mobile phone with limited battery

title: Train Accident at a Railway Crossing
situation: A passenger train has derailed near a railway crossing 5 km from a city. You arrive on scene with your team within 10 minutes of the incident. Approximately 200 passengers were on board. It is 6 PM and getting dark in about 40 minutes.
problems: 3 coaches have overturned. Around 50 passengers are trapped inside.
A fuel leak is visible near the engine — fire risk is high.
A local bus carrying 30 passengers has stalled on the railway tracks ahead.
Injured passengers are scattered over a 300-meter radius.
Only one road leads to the site and it is blocked by spectators.
resources: A nearby petrol station with a tow chain

title: Highway Building Site Accident
situation: A construction site for a national highway has experienced a partial structure collapse. Workers are trapped. The site is 15 km from the nearest hospital. You are in charge of the rescue with your 10-member team. Time available before next shift handover: 1 hour.
problems: 6 workers are trapped under debris; at least 2 are critically injured.
A crane on site has an oil leak and might catch fire.
One worker is hanging on a partially collapsed scaffolding 8 meters high.
There is only one working stretcher on site.
The site manager has gone into a panic and is obstructing rescue.
resources: 2 construction cranes (one with oil leak, one functional)
Basic first aid, no oxygen cylinders

title: Forest Fire Near a Tribal Village
situation: A rapidly spreading forest fire is heading toward a remote tribal village of 400 residents. Wind speeds are high. You have approximately 90 minutes before the fire reaches the village perimeter. Your team of 7 must coordinate evacuation and containment.
problems: Around 60 elderly and children cannot walk fast — need transport.
The only motorable path is 4 km and partly blocked by fallen trees.
A small stream 500m from the village could serve as a firebreak.
Tribal residents are reluctant to leave their homes due to cultural beliefs.
Valuable livestock belonging to 20 families are loose and panicking.
resources: Village elder (respected figure who can help communicate)

title: Riot at a Pilgrimage Site
situation: A religious pilgrimage site has seen clashes between two groups over access to a sacred shrine. The crowd has swelled to approximately 2,000 people. You are in charge of a team of 12. Situation is volatile — any mishandling could escalate. The main shrine must remain accessible to all.
problems: A group of 200 people is blocking the main gate, refusing to move.
3 people have been injured in stone pelting; one critically.
A local politician is inciting the crowd via a loudspeaker.
Media crews have arrived and are broadcasting live.
A small fire has been started in one of the outer stalls.
resources: Vehicle with ambulance markings (no medical equipment)
Shrine priest (highly respected by both groups)
